name: obsidian-voice-transcription
description: Takes audio-note files from a local directory and transcribes them into text, while extracting metadata and tag information. The transcribed text is then placed into Obsidian with its accompanying metadata (frontmatter) and tags.

scripts.setup: mkdir -p .ffmpeg && cd .ffmpeg && wget https://github.com/mifi/ffmpeg-builds/releases/download/5.1.2/linux-x64-v5.1.1.tar.xz -O ffmpeg-ffprobe.xz && tar -xv --strip-components=1 -f ffmpeg-ffprobe.xz ffmpeg-5.1.1-amd64-static/ffmpeg ffmpeg-5.1.1-amd64-static/ffprobe

author: vincentbavtiz
